facts.fact: Liberia has signed a US$52 million build-operate-transfer concession with Austrian State Printing Company (OSD) for the NIDCRVS digital civil registration and vital statistics system, which the House of Representatives referred to a joint committee on 16 October 2026 for a two-week review.

systems.system: National Identification Central Digital Civil Registration and Vital Statistics system (NIDCRVS)
